summary: No first-property configuration decisions can be supported from these calls. Every call was an unanswered outbound attempt, voicemail greeting, or automated phone menu; no RedPeak stakeholder discussed or approved an Entrata configuration. Keep catalog defaults for now and confirm the phone-routing design during discovery.
